catalog.name: Gravel sieve
catalog.description: Screen out stones. Faster panning; recover 92% of your gold instead of 82%.

catalog.name: Steel shovel & pick
catalog.description: Dig 10 kg per scoop, with shorter swings and deeper cuts.

catalog.name: Hauling pack
catalog.description: Carry 64 kg of gravel. More dirt means a heavier walk.

catalog.name: Prospector boots
catalog.description: Walk and sprint 20% faster while scouting your next claim.

catalog.name: Rocker box
catalog.description: Portable cradle. Load 96 kg; hold the crank to wash. Place near the creek.

catalog.name: Long tom & sluice
catalog.description: Continuous creek flow washes 7 kg per second. Load gravel; return for a clean-up.

catalog.name: Rustbucket excavator
catalog.description: Drive it. Scoop 180 kg at a time. Transfer your load into a nearby truck or washer.

catalog.name: Dump truck
catalog.description: Haul 2,400 kg. Pull beside an excavator to load, then tip gravel into a washer.

catalog.name: Trommel wash plant
catalog.description: Rotating screen, pump and sluices. Accepts truckloads; washes 32 kg per second.

catalog.name: The Widowmaker
catalog.description: Ridiculous hydraulic excavation rig. Blast 650 kg per burst. It still needs good ground.

catalog.name: Mine track bundle · 6 sections
catalog.description: Six two-metre rail sections. Snap on cleared level ground; adjoining sections form corners.

catalog.name: Tipping mine cart
catalog.description: Carries 240 kg. Push on rails, brake, load your bucket, catch dirt, and ride it up in the cage.

catalog.name: Hand-cranked cage hoist
catalog.description: Install at Crooked Hat shaft. Carries a cart and prospectors. Controls at each landing and aboard.

catalog.name: Shaft extension · 6 metres
catalog.description: Extend the shaft deeper with guides, emergency ladder and a new cleared landing.

catalog.name: Steam winding engine
catalog.description: Upgrade the cage to powered automatic travel. Tap I/K and keep exploring.

catalog.name: Hanging mine lantern
catalog.description: Place a light inside a cleared tunnel. Your belt lamp is included free.

catalog.name: Timber tunnel frame
catalog.description: A visible wooden support frame. Structural cave-in simulation is a future addition.
